summary: Lightweight renewal pipeline tracker used by CS to consolidate upcoming contract expirations, proposed renewal ARR, probability and next steps. Meant for week-by-week review in renewal standups. Mix of operational notes and sales-facing actions.
instructions:
- Keep rows sorted by nearest Renewal Date.
- Probability is CS estimate (use 0/25/50/75/100 buckets).
- Churn Risk: Low/Medium/High.
- Update Last Contact with YYYY-MM-DD when any substantive outreach occurs.
- Flag any enterprise security or legal blockers in Next Steps.
- Add JIRA ticket keys in Notes when applicable.
next_steps_guidance: Playbook quick wins: 1) If Probability >=75% and ARR >=100k, propose 12-month prepay discount. 2) If Churn Risk is High, assign SRE/Support to a rapid incident review and escalate to Solutions Eng. 3) For Private/VPC asks, surface to sales-engineering with required timeline and security checklist. Use linked confluence page for standard contract language.
